title: Volley Account Registry
description: The account registry file ($VOLLEY_AUTH_DIR/accounts.json) that `volley auth add|rotate|revoke|redeem` maintain and `account_list` returns (with last_seen added). Not an envelope; it never holds a password. See spec section 4.6.10.

name.description: The broker username (agent-id grammar; never a fixed identity, a reserved id or redeem-*).

label.description: The device a redeemed token's account is bound to.

last_seen.description: account_list only: the newest wall_time of the account's retained registry entry, its retained status (where its LWT lands), and its last auth request to the running supervisor.
